evidence: Modifies shared serialization logic in src/serialize.h, adds serialization unit tests, and refactors src/util/fs_helpers.
rationale: Standardizes file size types in utilities to prevent 32-bit architecture brittleness and adds unit test coverage for VarInt deserialization overflows. As commit fa2c8df181 notes, 'there is no test coverage at all for VarInt overflow behavior, so add test coverage for both overflow cases (and distinguish their error msg).'
